Added a fail-closed `supervisor_workflow_registered` readiness gate so enabling the supervisor flags fails admission closed (reason supervisor_workflow_not_registered) until the production MoonMind.OmnigentSession workflow is actually registered/wired, rather than silently admitting nothing. Full production Temporal workflow registration + launch-boundary invocation is tracked as the next #3712 integration step; this change makes the interim exposed settings safe-by-construction.
verify mode now checks a persisted cleanup marker (new has_cleanup_marker repository predicate) for mark_cleanup_required actions and reports missing_cleanup_marker discrepancies.

providerCapacityReleaseAllowed now requires both credential_consumers_stopped AND a new cleanup_completed terminal-evidence field, matching the reconciler release policy; a stopped consumer alone no longer authorizes release.

diagnostic_ref now has a field validator requiring a bounded, validated canonical `artifact://` reference (safe charset + length cap); raw provider-session/credential-looking values are rejected before they can be emitted into reports.

Machine-checkable refs now name concrete `module:symbol` targets and _ref_resolves resolves the symbol via getattr, so deleting a still-required class/function fails the guard even if its module remains; bare module refs are rejected.

rollback_metadata now emits reversal entries only for actions whose idempotency marker is present in the repository (await repo.is_applied), so a partial-failure run no longer lists unapplied side effects.
classify_record now routes a record that has a canonical session but still has an outstanding chat alias to ALIAS_REQUIRED (alias-producing) instead of new_model_ready/noop.

The activity now accepts only objective cleanupResult values before marking the host lease stopped. OmnigentOAuthHostRuntime.stop_host already raises OMNIGENT_HOST_CLEANUP_INCOMPLETE when the container, owned volumes, or runtime files remain, and the new activity regression proves a failed cleanup result leaves the validation lease nonterminal.

Bound-host revalidation now captures provider-login failures, always invokes lease-owned host cleanup, marks the lease stopped only after cleanup succeeds, and then propagates the original preflight failure. The activity regression exercises this failure ordering.

OAuth revalidation no longer creates or passes an empty execution workspace. The credential-only preflight mounts only the approved OAuth volume and runs the provider login-status command in the selected host image; its runtime test asserts that /workspaces/run is absent.

OAuth revalidation no longer waits for Omnigent host registration. The credential-only provider login check has a 60-second bound, leaving the existing 180-second activity budget for deterministic cleanup.
